description: Add something people can book (a room type, apartment, desk, office, meeting room, studio...), with its units and, optionally, its first rate so it can be booked straight away. Units are the individual bookable things: 4 identical studios is one listing with 4 units.

description.description: Shown on booking pages. Blank lines separate paragraphs

peoplePerUnit.description: How many people one unit holds

needsApproval.description: true: bookings are requests the business approves or declines (answer_request); the guest pays after approval

price.description: Price per night/hour/day/month/year in normal currency units, e.g. 25000

waysToPay.description: full: pay everything when booking. deposit_one_unit: pay the first night/day now (non-refundable), the rest on arrival. on_arrival: pay nothing now

webAddress.description: Slug for booking pages; made from the name if omitted

name: create_listing
title: Add a listing
